# Reference Guides

Lookup material. These pages are for checking a fact, not for learning a
workflow.

- [Glossary](glossary.qmd) defines every RECAP term used across the
  documentation.
- [Property and Parameter Access](property-and-parameter-access.qmd) lists every
  supported way to read and write resource properties and step parameters.
- [Server Configuration](server-configuration.qmd) lists every `ServerConfig`
  field, its default, and how YAML, environment variables, and CLI flags
  interact.
- [`recap-server` CLI](recap-server-cli.qmd) lists the command-line flags for
  the server entry point.

For exact Python signatures, parameters, and return models, see the generated
[API Reference](/reference/index.html).

For task instructions, see the [How-To Guides](../how-to/index.qmd). For
design rationale, see [Explanation](../explanation/index.qmd).
